user.title: Connect to Flexarr
user.description: The server's address and its API key, from Settings › Access in Flexarr.

data_description.api_key: Shown under Settings › Access in Flexarr's web app.

reauth_confirm.title: Flexarr's API key changed
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the new API key from Settings › Access in Flexarr.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Flexarr at that address.
error.invalid_auth: Flexarr didn't accept that API key.

abort.already_configured: This Flexarr server is already set up.

set_sound.name: Set sound
set_sound.description: Changes a device's dialogue boost, night mode or speakers. It reaches the device while Flexarr is open on it; anything left out stays as it is.

dialogue_boost.name: Dialogue boost
dialogue_boost.description: Makes voices easier to follow under music and effects.

night_mode.name: Night mode
night_mode.description: Quietens loud scenes and lifts quiet ones. Scheduled follows the hours set on the device.

speakers.name: Speakers
speakers.description: Folds the sound to stereo or 5.1; auto plays every channel the device's output takes.
